Suit
Glow

WASD to move, Shift to run, Space to jump and Space again mid-air to boost. Drag to look, scroll to zoom. M warp, E ride / shop / vend (and read, ask and inspect in the Archive, south of the plaza), F Worldsmith (describe a realm and it is built; it goes on forever, with landmarks invented as you walk), X fight back (a pulse where tech works, a ward where only magic does), B T H K the powers of any artifacts you hold, I inventory, J Explorer Log (every star on the Warp map is a planet), V camera, C cinematic, N sound, Esc this panel. A VR button appears when a headset is connected.

Left stick to move, Jump twice to boost, drag anywhere else to look. Warp is top right.

Warp

Jump straight to any world. Fares rise with sector distance; the Hub is always free, and walking through portals is free.

Pick a sector to see its stars. Every star is a planet you can land on.

Ledger Board

    Explorer Log

    Every planet you land on is charted here. Rename any of them; the name shows on your star map.

    Realm look

    Describe exactly how this realm should look in AI reality mode. It stays this way until you change it here.

    Real photo-scanned ground and rock (free, from Poly Haven), drawn by the game so they stay fixed like a normal game. They load automatically in the downloaded file.

    Live AI video mixed into the solid world: only far away, in portals and on screens. The ground you stand on is always the game's own.

    Worldsmith

    Describe a realm and the game builds it: the land, the ground, water, the time of day, weather, trees, buildings, colours. It gets its own sector on the star map, and going there is free.

    Your realms

    Outfitters

    Gear for your avatar. Buy once, keep forever, wear or remove any time. You have 0 credits.

    Vending terminal

    Supplies for the road. Bought items go to your bag (I) and are used from there. You have 0 credits.
